_comment: Default parameters for mouse EEG/EMG. A starting point, not a fixed recipe: check the EMG threshold histogram and the per-cluster PSDs on your first recording and adjust. Keys beginning with _ are comments and are ignored.

EEG._comment: binsize is the epoch length in seconds. normalized: false | mean | zscore | relative.

EMG._comment: 30-100 Hz avoids the EEG-dominated low frequencies. Set notch to 50 or 60 if nyx.check_signals reports mains pickup.

scoring._comment: min_duration in seconds: segments shorter than this are absorbed into their neighbours, removing single-epoch flicker.

steps._comment: EMG power separates wake from sleep. threshold null = find it automatically; check the histogram and override if the cut is not in a clear valley.
steps.name: wake_sleep

steps._comment: Split sleep into NREM and REM by clustering the EEG spectral PCA. stage_order names clusters from lowest to highest centroid on the first PC; REM has less low-frequency power, so it usually sits lower.
steps.name: split_sleep
